_readme: The compound lexicon (Nan, 2026-10-04: be ready when someone searches a drug or compound).
One row per active substance: class, a plain clause of what it is in each language, and every name a reader types.
importers/fda_register.py looks each row up on the Thai FDA drug register (pertento.fda.moph.go.th);
importers/answers_compounds.py builds the answer cards. Add a row by hand, or from notes/compound-gaps.txt.
